instruction.text: Entscheide, um welche Zeitform es sich handelt.

atoms.a: My cousin was born in Japan in 2003.
I have just done the dishes.
He was talking to his best friends.

instruction.text: Schreibe das jeweilige Verb in der genannten Zeitform in die Lücke.

atoms.b: Their uncle ((travelled)) to Paris by train.
While he ((was_listening)) to music, he was writing his diary.
Jenette ((had_worn)) jeans before she changed her clothes.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz, indem du das Verb in der richtigen Zeitform auswählst.

atoms.b: They ((++visited were_visiting)) a museum last week.
She ((++was_talking talked)) to her grandmother when her phone rang.
He ((++has_played had_played)) guitar in a band since he was a teenager.
My aunt ((++has_been_writing had_been_writing)) a book for two years.
We ((++had_lived have_been_living)) in Sydney before we moved to Melbourne.
It ((++had_been_raining had_rained)) all day before it stopped an hour ago.
